CongestionLowDialogContent:
The setting you have chosen would significantly reduce the bandwidth speeds you are able to reach.

To ensure a reasonable bandwidth speed, please select a higher value.
TourBandwidthAllocationButton: Once you’ve made changes, remember to confirm them by pressing Save. If you’d like to revert your changes, press Cancel.
TourBandwidthAllocationButtonTitle_aria: Bandwidth Allocation pointing to Save button
TourBandwidthAllocationHeader: Bandwidth Allocation lets you easily share your bandwidth between applications and devices. Any unused bandwidth is automatically shared.
TourBandwidthAllocationHeaderTitle_aria: Allocating Bandwidth pointing to the Bandwidth Allocation button
TourCancel: To take this tour again, open this options menu and press Start Tour.
TourCongestionControlHeader: Congestion Control stops greedy devices or applications from using all of your bandwidth, which can cause you to lag.
TourCongestionControlHeaderTitle_aria: Using Congestion Control pointing to the Congestion Control button
TourCongestionControlPage: We recommend that you use Ping Optimiser to find the best Congestion Control settings automatically.
TourCongestionControlPageTitle_aria: Optimise your ping pointing to the Ping Optimiser button
TourCreateRule: Press Create New Rule to choose other traffic to prioritise. By default, all supported gaming and work applications are prioritised.
TourCreateRuleTitle_aria: Adding Priority Traffic pointing to the Create New Rule button
TourFinish:
You’re all set! You now have everything you need to make your home network fit around your home life.

$t(qos:TourCancel)
TourFinishTitle_aria: Last step pointing to the 3 dot popup menu
TourPrioRules: Your priority traffic is automatically put before everything else on your network.
TourPrioRulesTitle_aria: Priority Traffic pointing to the gaming priority rule
TourSplashContent: $t(branding:com.netdumasoftware.qos) gives you power to decide which activities comes first on your network, to prevent frustrating interruptions with your online work or gaming.
bandwidthResetAlertInfo: This will reset your bandwidth allocation to default values
deleteRuleAlert: Are you sure you want to delete {{ruleName}}?
disableQosAlert: Are you sure you want to disable all $t(branding:com.netdumasoftware.qos) features? We do not recommend disabling $t(branding:com.netdumasoftware.qos) unless you are having issues reaching your full bandwidth speeds and you want to test if $t(branding:com.netdumasoftware.qos) was the cause. If you do decide to disable $t(branding:com.netdumasoftware.qos), then several other features on $t(branding:dumaosName) will also be disabled, including Adblocker and Traffic Controller. However, you can re-enable $t(branding:com.netdumasoftware.qos) at any time. Do you wish to proceed?
errorLanesOverlap: Unable to install because lanes overlap
errorPortOutOfRange: Please enter a valid whole number for each port between 1 and 65535
fullQosConfirmConfirm:
Are you sure you want to disable $t(qos:fullQoS)? Disabling $t(qos:fullQoS) removes the Congestion Control and Bandwidth Allocation features and is only recommended if your bandwidth speeds are more than 250mbps (almost all users have lower).
If you change your mind, you can re-enable $t(qos:fullQoS) at any time.
Would you like to disable $t(qos:fullQoS)?
goodputEnabledAlert: Each packet has a header usually about 40 - 60 bytes out of 1500 bytes. Bandwidth allocation includes the header by default, so for a test like speedtest which doesn't measure headers it will seem like your speed is lower than it is. Goodput means assign extra bandwidth to accommodate the headers so your bandwidth is closer to the speedtest result.
invalidBandwidthContent: Please enter a valid number within {{min}} and {{max}} mbps
manualServiceAddedAlert: You have manually added a service to your Traffic Prioritisation. This service will now be automatically prioritised by your router. You may experience congestion problems if the service you have added is used for high bandwidth intensity applications e.g. you have added Skype and you then use it for a video call.
qosDisabledPopupText: $t(branding:com.netdumasoftware.qos) has been disabled, so your traffic is no longer being prioritised. You can re-enable this feature in Settings.
shareExcessDesc: Share {{type}} bandwidth that is not in use with other devices or applications.
unsavedAlertInfo: If you leave before saving, your changes will be lost.
